component.summary: Zymfonix IDE. A Code - OSS based code editor.

description.p: Zymfonix IDE is an independent, Zymfonix-branded distribution of Code - OSS, the open-source project behind Visual Studio Code. It is built with the VSCodium build tooling and uses the Open VSX extension registry. It is not a Microsoft product.
